description: 건강 데이터 종합 — 중요도순. 일별 패널은 선택한 기간, '(월별)' 패널은 항상 최근 2년

panels.title: 지난밤 수면
panels.description: 가장 최근 밤의 총 수면 시간 (깨어있던 시간 제외). 권장 7–9시간

targets.rawSql:
WITH seg AS (
    SELECT toDate(end_time + INTERVAL 6 HOUR, '${tz}') AS night, source_name, category,
           dateDiff('second', start_time, end_time) AS secs, start_time, end_time
    FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
    WHERE type = 'sleep_analysis' AND category != 'in_bed' AND end_time > now() - INTERVAL 3 DAY
),
best AS (
    SELECT night, argMax(source_name, asleep) AS src
    FROM (SELECT night, source_name, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') AS asleep
          FROM seg GROUP BY night, source_name)
    GROUP BY night
),
nights AS (
    SELECT seg.night AS night, seg.source_name AS source_name, seg.category AS category,
           seg.secs AS secs, seg.start_time AS start_time, seg.end_time AS end_time
    FROM seg INNER JOIN best ON seg.night = best.night AND seg.source_name = best.src
)
SELECT sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') / 3600 AS v FROM nights WHERE night = (SELECT max(night) FROM nights)

panels.title: 총 수면 시간 (일별)
panels.description: 회색 선: 권장 최소 7시간

targets.rawSql:
WITH seg AS (
    SELECT toDate(end_time + INTERVAL 6 HOUR, '${tz}') AS night, source_name, category,
           dateDiff('second', start_time, end_time) AS secs, start_time, end_time
    FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
    WHERE type = 'sleep_analysis' AND category != 'in_bed' AND end_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') - INTERVAL 6 HOUR AND end_time < $__toTime
),
best AS (
    SELECT night, argMax(source_name, asleep) AS src
    FROM (SELECT night, source_name, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') AS asleep
          FROM seg GROUP BY night, source_name)
    GROUP BY night
),
nights AS (
    SELECT seg.night AS night, seg.source_name AS source_name, seg.category AS category,
           seg.secs AS secs, seg.start_time AS start_time, seg.end_time AS end_time
    FROM seg INNER JOIN best ON seg.night = best.night AND seg.source_name = best.src
)
SELECT time, asleep AS `수면 시간`,
       avg(asleep) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `7일 평균`
FROM (SELECT toDateTime(night, '${tz}') AS time, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') / 3600 AS asleep
      FROM nights GROUP BY time)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, v AS `일 평균`, avg(v) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `7일 평균`
FROM (SELECT toStartOfDay(start_time, '${tz}') AS time, avg(value) AS v FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
      WHERE type = 'heart_rate_variability' AND start_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') AND start_time < $__toTime GROUP BY time)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: 운동 시간 (월별 하루 평균)
panels.description: 회색 선: WHO 권장 주 150분 ≈ 하루 21분

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(d), '${tz}') AS time, avg(v) AS `운동 시간`
FROM (SELECT toDate(bucket_start, '${tz}') AS d, sumIf(value, type = 'step_count') AS steps,
             sumIf(value, type = 'exercise_time') AS v
      FROM ${db}.quantity_stats FINAL
      WHERE type IN ('step_count', 'exercise_time') AND $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
      GROUP BY d HAVING steps > 0 AND d < toDate(now(), '${tz}'))
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(start_time, '${tz}'), '${tz}') AS time, count() AS `운동 횟수`
FROM ${db}.workouts FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time WITH FILL FROM toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(toDate($__fromTime, '${tz}')), '${tz}') TO toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(toDate($__toTime, '${tz}')), '${tz}') + INTERVAL 1 MONTH STEP INTERVAL 1 MONTH

SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(d), '${tz}') AS time, avg(v) AS `활동 에너지`
FROM (SELECT toDate(bucket_start, '${tz}') AS d, sumIf(value, type = 'step_count') AS steps,
             sumIf(value, type = 'active_energy') AS v
      FROM ${db}.quantity_stats FINAL
      WHERE type IN ('step_count', 'active_energy') AND $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
      GROUP BY d HAVING steps > 0 AND d < toDate(now(), '${tz}'))
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(d), '${tz}') AS time, avg(v) AS `걸음 수`
FROM (SELECT toDate(bucket_start, '${tz}') AS d, sumIf(value, type = 'step_count') AS steps,
             sumIf(value, type = 'step_count') AS v
      FROM ${db}.quantity_stats FINAL
      WHERE type IN ('step_count', 'step_count') AND $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
      GROUP BY d HAVING steps > 0 AND d < toDate(now(), '${tz}'))
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: 걷기 비대칭 (월별)
panels.description: 좌우 걸음 시간 차이. iPhone을 바지 주머니에 넣고 걸을 때 측정되며, 휴대 방식에 따라 달라질 수 있음

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(start_time, '${tz}'), '${tz}') AS time, avg(value) * 100 AS `평균 비대칭`,
       countIf(value > 0.2) / count() * 100 AS `20% 초과 측정 비율`
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL WHERE type = 'walking_asymmetry' AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfDay(start_time, '${tz}') AS time, transform(type, ['walking_asymmetry'], ['걷기 비대칭'], type) AS series, avg(value) AS value
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type IN ('walking_asymmetry') AND start_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') AND start_time < $__toTime
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(start_time, '${tz}'), '${tz}') AS time, avg(value) * 3.6 AS `걷기 속도`
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL WHERE type = 'walking_speed' AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(start_time, '${tz}'), '${tz}') AS time, avg(value) * 100 AS `보폭`
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL WHERE type = 'walking_step_length' AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT start_time AS time, transform(type, ['body_mass', 'lean_body_mass'], ['체중', '제지방량'], type) AS series,
       value FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type IN ('body_mass', 'lean_body_mass') AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY time

SELECT start_time AS time, value AS `체지방률` FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type = 'body_fat_percentage' AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: 심박 알림 (월별 횟수)
panels.description: Apple Watch의 높은/낮은 심박·불규칙 리듬 알림 합계. 기록이 없다면 Watch 앱 › 심장에서 알림이 켜져 있는지 확인

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(start_time, '${tz}'), '${tz}') AS time, count() AS `심박 알림`
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type IN ('high_heart_rate_event', 'low_heart_rate_event', 'irregular_heart_rhythm_event')
  AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time WITH FILL FROM toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(toDate($__fromTime, '${tz}')), '${tz}') TO toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(toDate($__toTime, '${tz}')), '${tz}') + INTERVAL 1 MONTH STEP INTERVAL 1 MONTH
SELECT argMax(device_name, received_at) AS v FROM ${db}.sync_log
SELECT count() AS v FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
SELECT count() AS v FROM ${db}.workouts FINAL

SELECT $__timeInterval(received_at) AS time, sum(samples) AS `샘플`, sum(stats) AS `시간별 통계`, sum(workouts) AS `운동`
FROM ${db}.sync_log WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT type AS `타입`, '샘플' AS `구분`, count() AS `건수`, min(start_time) AS `최초`, max(end_time) AS `최신`
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL GROUP BY type
UNION ALL SELECT type, '시간별 통계', count(), min(bucket_start), max(bucket_end) FROM ${db}.quantity_stats FINAL GROUP BY type
UNION ALL SELECT 'workout', '운동', count(), min(start_time), max(end_time) FROM ${db}.workouts FINAL HAVING count() > 0
ORDER BY 1, 2
